question: Should this internal abort-race fix require a delayed real gateway/plugin-binding cancellation run, or should the focused source-level regression receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: The implementation and deterministic test are convincing at the source boundary, but repository policy treats the mocked transport, plugin, binding, and dispatcher layers as insufficient real behavior proof for an external PR.

options.title: Require live cancellation proof
options.body: Run a real gateway with an installed test plugin that delays routed delivery, abort during the delay, and provide redacted logs showing no routed or fallback reply.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the deterministic focused test as sufficient for this timing-only invariant and explicitly override the external-PR real behavior proof gate.

recommendation.title: Require live cancellation proof
recommendation.body: Run a real gateway with an installed test plugin that delays routed delivery, abort during the delay, and provide redacted logs showing no routed or fallback reply.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin-binding routing surface and its original live external-plugin validation trace most directly to this owner.
